meta.notes: Served by ShotoPhopEX's native worker (gn-diffusion qwen-2.1/angles): the Qwen-Image-2.1 edit with akhaliq's Multiple Angles v2 LoRA (huggingface.co/akhaliq/Qwen-Image-2.1-Multiple-Angles-LoRA, checkpoints_v2 step 1500, Apache-2.0, read 2026-11-17) at strength 1 in front of the request's own LoRAs. The prompt is the LoRA's vocabulary, `<mva> {azimuth}, {elevation}[ close-up]`, built by generate.angles. generate.angles runs it instead of qwen-edit-2511/angles on cards without fp8 matrix cores (compute capability under 8.9: RTX 30 and older), where 2511's fp8 file does not run (a 3090 crashed; this route took 21.7 GB and 24 s warm there, 2026-11-17). The LoRA was trained on Objaverse renders at 512 px: it turns the camera on real photos but may simplify the background. No ComfyUI graph.
